identityReview: Matched ASML executive across official management biography, appointment documents and Airbus board announcement. French national born 1973. Excluded same-name French bobsledder returned by English Wikipedia and Wikidata Q2966242; sports dates and images must not be imported.
lifeStatusEvidence: October 14, 2026 SEC-filed ASML results quote Fouquet as president and CEO discussing customer demand and future capacity. Current ASML management page also confirms role.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read ASML management biography and April 2024 company story, Airbus biography and October 2026 board release, SEC-filed Q3 2026 release, selected appointment passages in the 2024 corporate-governance PDF, original November 2023 succession release PDF and Milken speaker biography. Old ASML release URLs redirected to news indexes; Euronext HTML requested JavaScript and SEC full annual-report HTML exceeded tool size limit. Successful PDF sources used for those historical claims.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, education, business leadership chronology, distinct governance bodies, succession, Airbus co-option and recent activity.
corrections: ASML biography explicitly gives French nationality and 1973 birth year. No exact birth date or unverified birthplace adopted; same-name athlete records are excluded.

Physics master’s degree from Institut Polytechnique de Grenoble, not a doctorate. No graduation year inferred. Applied Materials and KLA Tencor preceded ASML; no unsupported explanation for gaps in the abbreviated career list.

ASML management biography and 2024 story distinguish 2018 EUV leadership and Board of Management entry from 2022 chief business officer appointment. Airbus biography incorrectly compresses 2018 board entry into appointment as chief business officer; that clause is not followed.

Applications executive vice president 2013–2018, EUV 2018–2022, chief business officer 2022–2024. Milken confirms this but explicitly says biographies and headshots are speaker-supplied and not independently verified.
November 30, 2023 original PDF announces intention to appoint, subject to AGM notification. It does not establish that Fouquet was already CEO in 2023 or January 2024.

Annual-report remuneration notes explicitly say appointed president and CEO April 24, 2024; company story says new role started April 25. Timeline uses month and states both descriptions rather than silently choosing one exact day.
Peter Wennink was outgoing CEO and Martin van den Brink outgoing CTO, both co-presidents. Do not call both former co-CEOs or assert Fouquet simultaneously became CTO.
Board of Management and Supervisory Board are different bodies. Profile does not label him Supervisory Board chair or confuse Airbus non-executive directorship with Airbus chief executive or chair.

Airbus October 1, 2026 release confirms co-option to complete René Obermann’s remaining directorship. Amparo Moraleda succeeded as chair. Planned full three-year mandate at April 2027 AGM is not already approved.

Q3 2026 release contains actual reported quarter and forward-looking customer demand and 2027–2028 capacity assessments. Future expectations are not delivered systems or realized annual results. Team and partner contributions preserved rather than claiming sole invention of EUV.
sourceReview.limits: AI authorship and review, not human/native-language certification. Selected annual-report passages reviewed, not a complete financial audit; corporate forecasts not independently validated.

portraitReview.rightsEvidence: Official ASML and Airbus biographies expose portrait assets, but no adequate reuse grant was established. Search also returned Reuters commercial licensing pages, not a free-use license.
portraitReview.unresolved: No authorized original downloaded or visually approved. Search did not establish a suitable Commons file; this does not prove none exists. Same-name athlete images must be excluded.

translationReview.scope: All 32 Chinese fields and seven translations checked for physics master’s degree, distinct corporate governance bodies, 2018/2022 roles, 2023 intention versus 2024 appointment and start, Airbus co-option versus future election, and future supply assessments.
